title: SG-5.4 Asset preload and validation with fallback used by the scene
summary: Add a preload and validation step with a missing-asset fallback, and use it in the scene
description: Context: BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no preload(); scene object and dust asset ids in bedroom.yaml are never validated against the manifest at load time. Desired behavior: a pure engine planner decides which manifest assets the scene needs and reports unknown or missing ones, and BootScene preloads them and substitutes a fallback texture for any that are missing. Why: missing assets must not crash the scene.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene whose objects and effects reference manifest ids, When the preload plan is built, Then it lists each referenced asset once with its path, type and frame spec
Given a scene referencing an id absent from the manifest or a file that fails to load, When the scene runs, Then the fallback texture key is used and no exception is thrown
Given BootScene starts, When Phaser calls preload, Then the planned assets are queued through the planner
technical_constraints: Engine modules under game/src stay Phaser-free and take injected contexts
definition_of_done: Both requirements are implemented, verified and the scene uses the preload step
non_functional: Unit tests run with Phaser mocked
